result.summary: Adds microbenchmarks for BIP-352 Silent Payments public key extraction (bip352::GetPubKeyFromInput) to bench_bitcoin. The suite tests standard input types—P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WPKH, and P2TR script-path spend—as well as a worst-case malleated P2PKH scriptSig designed to maximize hash iterations under consensus limits.
result.problem: Silent Payments input parsing and key extraction logic has seen bug fixes and ongoing adjustments without dedicated benchmarks to evaluate execution overhead or protect against performance regressions.
evidence: The PR author notes ongoing updates to GetPubKeyFromInput in recently merged #36338 and open #36417.
Benchmark figures from the description show that standard input extraction runs in ~2.8 to 3.0 µs, whereas the worst-case malleated P2PKH input takes ~69.9 µs (a ~23x slowdown).
result.scope_notes: Adds benchmark code only; introduces no production logic changes.
result.changed_since_previous: Updated the P2TR benchmark input from a key-path spend to a script-path spend to exercise control block checking and NUMS-H internal key comparisons.
result.card: Adds microbenchmarks for BIP-352 Silent Payments public key extraction (bip352::GetPubKeyFromInput) to bench_bitcoin. The benchmarks evaluate standard spend types (P2PKH, P2SH-P2WPKH, P2WPKH, P2TR script-path) along with an adversarial worst-case malleated P2PKH scriptSig. Benchmark numbers in the description demonstrate a 23x performance penalty under worst-case inputs, establishing a baseline to track performance across related Silent Payments PRs like #36338 and #36417.

risk.why: Only introduces standalone microbenchmarks in bench_bitcoin and touches no node or consensus code.
